name: Refrigerator
description:
Club Rainbow (Singapore) is seeking the donation of a refrigerator for our AMK Resilience Hub to support daily living skills training under our Transition Care Plan programme.

Through guided practice, our clients will learn to store ingredients and prepared meals safely, organise chilled and frozen items, check expiry dates and maintain refrigerator cleanliness. These activities will help build their confidence and independence in managing food at home.

We welcome a new or pre-loved refrigerator in good working condition, preferably with separate fridge and freezer compartments. As it will be used for halal food storage, any pre-loved unit must have been used exclusively to store halal food.

Your donation will support hands-on learning and help our clients develop essential skills for everyday living. Thank you for supporting their journey towards greater independence.
